actions.text: Choose how long a guest cart is kept.

items.title: Request timeout raised
items.why: Token checks call the key service once per cold start.

items.title: Retry on 503
items.after: A request that returns 503 is retried twice.

items.title: Sessions no longer expire on idle
items.why: A signed token cannot be revoked by the server between requests.
items.before: A session ends after 15 idle minutes.
items.after: A session lasts until the token expires after 12 hours.

items.title: Token lifetime contradicts the audit rule
items.before: A token is valid for 12 hours.
items.after: Every session must end within 8 hours.

results.heading: Tests and load
results.summary: Median latency dropped because the session lookup is gone; the slowest requests are unchanged.

decisions.question: How long is a guest cart kept?
decisions.context: Carts used to live in the session. They now need a lifetime of their own.
